component.name: WatermelonDS
component.summary: Nintendo DS and DSi emulator with a modern frontend and RetroAchievements

description.p: WatermelonDS is a Nintendo DS and DSi emulator frontend and core based on melonDS, inspired by the WatermelonDS Android project.

ul.li: Modern game library launcher with box art and recent shelf
Integrated RetroAchievements support with automatic hashing and golden badges
In-game floating control bar with frame stepping, pausing, resetting, and settings
Unified categorized settings dialog with visual DS controller mapping
High-resolution OpenGL 3D rendering and software renderer
Full audio, microphone, and controller support

description.p: Initial release of WatermelonDS Desktop with modern launcher, floating HUD, unified settings, and RetroAchievements.
